row: For the love of aging dogs! We love our furry friends and watching our playful young dogs grow into older dogs and ultimately senior dogs can be difficult.  We want to help them any way possible and love them as long as we can.  Senior dogs can live happy comfortable lives if they stay healthy and mobile.  We’re obsessed with delivering insanely useful tools, training and products to our community who love their dogs. Our mission is to take the best and latest of what’s been tested and proven in helping dogs at home.  We work with the best of the best in the canine world to enable humans around the world help their loving aging dogs live longer and pain free.  One such amazing resource is Carrie Smith, a certified Canine Rehabilitation therapist with 14 years experience working with dogs on top of her 30+ years working with humans.  People travel great distances for their aging, injured or recovering dogs to see Carrie but we are bringing her into your home.
